summary.plain: The building at Fermilab, near Chicago, that holds the 14-metre superconducting ring used by the Muon g-2 experiment to measure a tiny wobble in spinning muons.
summary.technical: MC-1 building on the Fermilab site (Muon Campus), housing the Muon g-2 (E989) storage ring, cryogenics plant and counting room. No building-specific sourced coordinate was found this session; recorded as a campus-level approximate point.
